title: Action record schema: OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions + tamper-evident log
outcome: A draft per-action record schema mapped to OTel GenAI attributes, with the gaps (state read/write sets) and a tamper-evidence mechanism chosen
acceptance: ≥5 primary sources with URLs, including the official OTel GenAI semconv spec (with version/stability status) and RFC 9162 or Sigstore Rekor/Trillian docs
Field table: proposed action-record field × OTel attribute if one exists (or 'gap') × why TTI/TTC/recovery needs it
Comparison of ≥3 tamper-evidence options (hash chain, Merkle log, transparency log) on guarantees, verification cost, prototype effort
'Implications for our design' section for Recorder and Monitor
